## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits, for example `feat(api): add domain verification`.
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated.
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs in `docs/` are updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or credentials appear in logs, fixtures or screenshots.
- [ ] Migration impact is described in the summary, or there is none: database migrations (committed in `apps/api/drizzle`), configuration or environment variable changes, breaking API changes.
